trap-superlative.notes: NUMERIC CONTRADICTION (verified): 'The e- coefficient (~13.4 including the descended part) is only 12% of the total mass element norm' does not follow from the block's own a-values under any natural norm. With a_1=86.2, a_3=37.4, a_5=13.4: plain sum 13.4/137.0 = 9.78%; sum with basis multiplicity (2 sigma, 2 L) 13.4/260.6 = 5.14%; Euclidean without multiplicity 13.4/94.92 = 14.12%; Euclidean with multiplicity 13.4/133.56 = 10.03%. None is 12%. Either the norm convention must be stated or the figure regenerated by its producer.

trap-nonspeakable.notes: Rigor pass, three items. (1) VERIFIED CORRECT: the Li_2(q^-2) mod-3 grouping fractions. Recomputed S_k = sum_{n = k mod 3} q^{-2n}/n^2 to 40 dps over 4000 terms: S_1 = 76.96%, S_2 = 16.66%, S_0 = 6.384% of Li_2, matching the tabulated 76.9 / 16.7 / 6.4. The fractions are pin-insensitive (identical to 4 digits at the old-muon, current-muon, proton and 1.1097 values), so they do not discriminate the anchor. (2) PIN CURRENCY: the Witness line reads 'q_0 = 1.109978595554181... (muon pin, 16 dps)'. That is the OLD muon value (current CAL-2 pin is 1.10997859555733471; they diverge at the 12th significant digit), and per the 2026-08-07 owner directive compute defaults to the proton pin 1.1099785827513808. Arithmetically the string is fine and the conclusions are unaffected, so this is pin-currency, not a corrupt number; also '16 dps' labels a value with 15 decimal places. (3) The a-coefficients do not reproduce from the same grouping: Li_2/hbar_q^2 = 111.895 at either muon value, so Li_2/hbar_q^2 times the three fractions gives 86.11 / 18.64 / 7.14 against the tabulated 86.2 / 37.4 / 13.4 — a_1 matches to 0.1% but a_3 is 2.006x and a_5 is 1.876x the naive value, so no single multiplicity convention reproduces the column. Worth naming the producer. (4) Section 3b: the .ts uses[] names conj:mass-endomorphism directly, but the .md carries the required conditional banner ('Proposition (conditional on conj:mass-endomorphism)'), so this is NOT a bare propagation violation.
